intro.summary: St. Dymphna is a 7th-century Irish saint and martyr venerated for her courage and faith amid persecution.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Dymphna Novena - Prayers for Mental Illnesses below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: Expanded “St.” to “Saint” for clearer text-to-speech and added a comma for natural pacing.; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Lord, our God, you graciously chose Saint Dymphna as patroness of those afflicted with mental and nervous disorders. She is thus an inspiration and a symbol of charity to the thousands who ask her intercession. Please grant, Lord, through the prayers of this pure youthful martyr, relief and consolation to all suffering such trials, and especially those for whom we pray.

Saint Dymphna, Virgin and Martyr, pray for us. We beg you, Lord, to hear the prayers of Saint Dymphna on our behalf. Grant all those for whom we pray patience in their sufferings and resignation to Your Divine Will. Please fill them with hope, and grant them the relief and cure they so much desire. We ask this through Christ our Lord, who suffered agony in the garden. Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
